business_name: Blue Mirror Pools / Brighton Pools by Costa
hero_subtext: This is the text-message demo version: premium look, visible trust, and a clean path to quote. Instead of a thin listing, homeowners land on a site that feels established, expensive, and ready to book.
pitch_headline: 74 reviews. 4.9 stars. No luxury front door.
pitch_body: Lead with the proof they already earned, then show how the same reputation could be packaged into something that feels like a real design-build brand instead of another contractor listing.
text_line: 74 reviews at 4.9 and no website. 30-sec SuperSite demo for Blue Mirror / Brighton.
call_script: Hey, this is Bryan with JAWSAI. Blue Mirror and Brighton are sitting at 4.9 with 74 reviews. Good reputation, nothing converting it online. I built a quick demo - reviews up front, after-hours lead capture, follow-up so quotes don't go cold. 30 seconds.
section_title: Show them a site that feels premium before they ever pick up.
section_copy: Liquid Luxe works because it sells aspiration, not just service. This demo follows that same idea: strong hero image, elegant type, review proof, and a quote path that feels more like a luxury brand than a local directory page.
gallery_caption_title: Luxury pool positioning, not commodity contractor energy.
gallery_caption_body: Use the Loom to frame this as a concept: better first impression, stronger trust, and a cleaner way to convert quote traffic that currently dies after hours.

why_cards.title: Reviews up front
why_cards.body: The rating and review count are in the hero immediately so a homeowner sees trust before they start comparing quotes.

why_cards.title: After-hours capture
why_cards.body: The pitch is not just aesthetics. It is a digital front door that catches nighttime demand and moves it into follow-up instead of losing it.

why_cards.title: Luxury brand framing
why_cards.body: The whole page positions the company as a design-driven backyard builder, which is a better pricing conversation than looking like a generic service listing.

process_bodies: Send this page link with the short line. Let the page do the heavy lifting before the call even starts.
Walk the hero, the review proof, and the quote path in under a minute. Focus on what this changes for after-hours leads and trust.
The pitch is simple: the business already earned the reputation. The site should finally look like it.
cta_title: This is the template to clone.
cta_body: Keep the layout, keep the premium pool photography, and just swap business name, phone, city, and review proof. That is stronger than sending twenty thin pages that all feel disposable.
footer_note: Reference direction: Liquid Luxe hero and luxury-pool positioning. Review excerpts sourced from Angi and the Blue Mirror Pools website on July 28, 2026.
photo_source_note: Use generic premium pool imagery by default. Swap to business-specific Google profile photos only when they are strong enough to help.
loom_angle: Lead with premium positioning, review proof, and after-hours conversion instead of talking about a generic website redesign.
